title: the runner, turn after turn
line: the runner takes the queue's first person, runs their turn with the network standing in (a challenge at a connector is an error run and the turn goes on), names them again and passes them over once their turn held nothing new, runs the next person and stops with the turn's state kept when that turn pauses on pages to save, refusing a fresh run while it is paused; --resume picks the paused turn up, passes its person over the same way when nothing came back, goes on to the next person, who has nothing to pause on once her marriage-index citation is blocked, and the run finishes its own turn budget with its state cleared; a fresh run starts the count again

steps.say: the home person's parents confirmed on the owner's word, so the queue names the home person's own open question, then the grandparents

two turns: the first person's turn holds nothing new (a challenge at the first connector, an error run; nothing at the rest), and the queue names them again, so they are passed over; the next person's turn pauses on pages to save

expect.why: the home person's turn ran and held nothing new; named again, he is passed over; the grandfather's turn paused
the paused turn's own state is kept, as turn.py keeps it
the runner's state is kept beside the turn's, and the summary says what stopped it
the challenge is an error run: the source did not answer, the step stays runnable and the next turn asks it again

steps.say: a fresh run while a turn is paused is refused

resumed with nothing saved: the paused turn is finished and its person, named again with nothing new, is passed over; the grandmother's own marriage-index citation is blocked (no page-locating step), so her turn has nothing to pause on and finishes too; the run's own budget of three turns is done, and its state is cleared

expect.why: the resumed turn counts as the second; its person is passed over once named again; the grandmother is the third, and pauses on nothing now that her marriage-index citation is blocked
nobody pauses, so no state is kept
the run ends on its own turn budget, its state file gone

steps.say: a fresh run starts the count again: the queue names the home person first as before, and nobody is passed over for the last run's reasons

expect.why: a new run: the home person's turn runs once more, nobody passed over yet
